en: Black‑and‑white image showing a formation of uniformed soldiers with rifles standing in ranks along a cobbled courtyard beside a substantial red‑brick building with striped stone bands and arched windows. Several officers and guards stand on the entrance steps under decorative ironwork and large gas‑style lamps. A high metal fence lines the right side, and flagpoles rise behind the building, suggesting the guarded entrance to an important public or government facility in a European city around the early 20th century.
